subject: Day 68 — your key to the vault
preview_text: You're one of 47 users getting this. Here's what's inside.
body_paragraphs: I won't lie — I almost didn't send this. But you've been with us since day one, and that earns a seat at the table. Not the marketing table. The real one.

Here's the thing: our AI doesn't just analyze charts. It sees the same patterns institutions pay six figures for. Most users never touch the feature that unlocks that edge — because they don't know it exists. You're about to be one of the few who does.

Open your app, tap the little crown icon in the top right. That's your key to the Strategy Vault — a daily feed of trade setups our AI flagged with 80%+ confidence in the last 12 hours. Updated every 4 hours. No noise, no hype. Just the signal.
Go check the Strategy Vault now. The next update drops in 2 hours. P.S. — this vault usually stays behind a $99/month wall. For you, it's open until Sunday midnight. Use it or lose it.
